answer: Boring version: escrow the fee, grade the job, stream the payout over thirty days. Replay matches a submission against its first signed copy, so a rename does not hide a duplicate; the clone shows up as the same payload. That leaves the copycat with an island of unvested balance while the tide of real work moves on. Cost: a month of duplicated labour per clone, paid in full, released to nobody. Even a velvet-smooth alias cannot launder the hash.
